smyx-driver-blink-fatigue-detection-analysis v1.0.0

- Initial release for real-time driver fatigue detection using in-cabin DMS camera.
- Detects driver eye open/closed state, calculates blink rate, and identifies prolonged eye closures (microsleep precursors).
- Triggers in-cabin voice or seat-vibration alerts and uploads events to fleet management platform when fatigue is detected.
- Provides clear workflow for open-id retrieval, with mandatory user identification before analysis.
- Strict handling and display of historical driving fatigue reports with detailed Markdown output.
- Usable in passenger, commercial, ride-hailing, and freight fleet scenarios, with clear privacy requirements.
